name: TEXCYCL
recent: Tex Cycle 在 2026 年 11 月 17 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止的季度业绩，新闻指出第三季营收同比增长 42%，但利润增长受利润率压缩拖累；首九个月净利同比增长 22% 至 890 万令吉。公司近期也出现董事部与薪酬委员会人事变动，包括 Lee Hai Peng 与 Keh Chuan Yee 的职务调整，以及公司秘书变更。
notable: 公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止的季度业绩，新闻指出第三季营收同比增长 42%，首九个月净利同比增长 22% 至 890 万令吉。
Lee Hai Peng 卸任董事职务，并退出薪酬委员会。
Keh Chuan Yee 退出薪酬委员会，此前已于 2026 年 9 月 18 日出现董事部变动。
risks: 新闻指出第三季利润增长受利润率压缩拖累。
公司近期出现董事部与薪酬委员会人事变动。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 2,416 万令吉，环比增长 17.3%，同比增长 179.8%；净利为 315 万令吉，环比下降 11.4%，同比增长 4.3%；净利率为 13.0%，低于上一季度的 17.2%。

recent_en: Tex Cycle announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 17 November 2026, with news reporting Q3 revenue up 42% year-on-year but profit growth lagging on margin squeeze; 9M net profit rose 22% year-on-year to RM8.9 million. The company also saw boardroom and remuneration committee changes involving Lee Hai Peng and Keh Chuan Yee, as well as a change of company secretary.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026; news reported Q3 revenue up 42% year-on-year and 9M net profit up 22% year-on-year to RM8.9 million.
Lee Hai Peng ceased to be a director and member of the Remuneration Committee.
Keh Chuan Yee ceased to be a member of the Remuneration Committee, following a boardroom change on 18 September 2026.
risks_en: News noted that Q3 profit growth was weighed by margin squeeze.
The company recently saw boardroom and remuneration committee changes.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM24.16 million, up 17.3% QoQ and up 179.8% YoY; net income was RM3.15 million, down 11.4% QoQ and up 4.3% YoY; net margin was 13.0%, lower than 17.2% in the previous quarter.
